missing_bends: End panel 5/6 shallow bend: a 10.6-10.9 deg formed bend between the main plate (top skin 2 / bottom skin 1) and the end panel (top skin 6 / bottom skin 5). Plane fits give 10.64 deg for 2-6 and 10.94 deg for 1-5. Old notes excluded it only because of the 15 deg rule. Under the 2026-10-18 owner rule (>= 10 deg counts) it is a bend. It is a real formed fold, not an artifact or an incidental roll: both skins kink together at the same station, the slope goes from 0 to about -10 deg over ~3 mm (radius about 16 mm, as expected for a shallow air bend), the end panel past it is a clean flat plane, the angle is constant across the full ~19.6 mm width, and the fold axis is parallel to B1 (0.37 deg). The legacy human count of 4 matches it. Suggested outer-apex (top skin 2/6, convex side) line in source_ply_raw: start [-174.316, -99.115, 157.425], end [-155.263, -94.448, 156.899] (~19.6 mm long, the plane 2/6 intersection, measured top-skin apex ~0.08 mm below it). It could be built with pairs [2],[6], skin outer.
